about: The fixes register. Rules: tools/tracking.py; process: docs/VERSIONING.md. Never delete an entry or reuse an id.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The writer emitted a single phraseIteration at the start beat; Rocksmith ends playback at the last phraseIteration.
items.solution: The writer emits COUNT at the first beat, a default phrase at the first note and END past the last note's tail, and closes the sections with a 'noguitar' section.
items.regression_risk: Removing the END phrase brings the early song end back.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The convert-external-source flow used a blank project's 'Vorbis Quality High' preset, which writes no seek table.
items.solution: wwise.py extracts the vendored DLC Builder template project for the detected Wwise version, runs generate-soundbank and patches the header word at offset 40 to 3.
items.regression_risk: Simplifying the conversion back to convert-external-source would silence every song again.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The writer did not emit the full set of 32 arrangementProperties attributes.
items.solution: The writer emits every arrangementProperties attribute, deriving the technique flags from the notes, and a test pins the required list.
items.regression_risk: A new attribute DLC Builder starts reading would need adding to the list.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Writer emitted a partial Song2014 structure that did not follow Rocksmith2014.NET's schema.
items.solution: Added the missing elements in schema order, corrected arrangementProperties to SongArrangementProperties2014's set and added the chord attributes.
items.regression_risk: Low: additive XML elements checked by later schema tests.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The offset was applied to both audio and score instead of aligning the score to the recording.
items.solution: offset_s now means the second in the recording where the first note is heard; score and lyrics shift there and the audio is padded only up to MIN_LEAD_S.
items.regression_risk: Medium: core timing rule; later sections build on it.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: <offset> was not set to -startBeat.
items.solution: Set Song2014 offset = -startBeat.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: No minimum lead-in before the first note.
items.solution: Prepend silence so the first note is at least MIN_LEAD_S (2 s) in.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Warning emitted unconditionally.
items.solution: Only warn (merged into the padding warning) when the offset was below MIN_LEAD_S.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: STRING_COLORS mapping and order wrong.
items.solution: Corrected the mapping and reversed the order.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Chord-level flags not mirrored from the notes.
items.solution: Set chord-level flags when every note in the chord carries them.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The warp extrapolated (later: shifted) outside the anchor range.
items.solution: Outside the anchor range the warp first held the shift constant, then became identity for two or more anchors (one anchor stays a uniform shift); the JS preview mirrors it.
items.regression_risk: JS and Python warps must agree.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Default-valued attributes emitted.
items.solution: Omit attributes equal to their schema default (_drop_defaults), as EOF does.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Coordinate mismatch between viewer capture space and backend warp space.
items.solution: Capture and draw anchors in previewScale display space and warp after previewScale.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: pending
items.solution: Reset the tick position on backward seek.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: whisperx>=3.4 requires pyannote-audio>=4.0 / numpy>=2.1, which conflicts with the numpy<2 pin of the other stack.
items.solution: pyproject.toml pins whisperx <3.4.
items.regression_risk: Bumping whisperx without re-checking the numpy ranges brings the resolver failure back.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: No Redis detection/launch check.
items.solution: Reuse a listening Redis, else launch memurai/redis-server from PATH, else print an install hint and abort.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Endpoint ignored params['lrc_text'].
items.solution: Fall back to parsing lrc_text when no events exist.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Cover file not copied to the forked job's work dir.
items.solution: Copy the cover into the new work directory on rebuild.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Loose scipy lower bound from basic-pitch.
items.solution: Pin scipy>=1.11.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Unpinned torch/torchaudio.
items.solution: Pin torch<2.5 and torchaudio<2.5.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: ffmpeg (and Demucs) were started without -nostdin / stdin=DEVNULL, so they read the inherited console stdin.
items.solution: FfmpegNormalizer passes -nostdin and stdin=DEVNULL with a timeout so a real stall fails loudly; DemucsSeparator also uses stdin=DEVNULL.
items.regression_risk: Dropping those flags in a new subprocess call would bring the hang back.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: <audio> currentTime/seek imprecision on VBR sources.
items.solution: Playback uses an AudioBufferSourceNode over the decoded buffer with a custom transport; <audio> is only a decode-failure fallback.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Overlapping setInterval polls re-loading arrangements.
items.solution: Re-arm the poll with setTimeout, load arrangements once per job, try/catch around it.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: UI wiring never implemented.
items.solution: Implemented the tone builder module (catalogue, pickers, knobs, save/delete, base/extra/changes).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: A known ctranslate2 CUDA-init deadlock in Celery child processes (faster-whisper #907, celery #3402).
items.solution: WhisperX import check and transcription run in a subprocess (_whisperx_runner.py) with WHISPERX_TIMEOUT_S.
items.regression_risk: Subprocess must not inherit stdin; timeouts must cover model downloads.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Concurrent cuInit() from the warm-up thread and the task.
items.solution: The warm-up was removed; the first task pays the CUDA init once (@cache).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: SQLAlchemy compares the JSON column by identity; job.params aliased and reassigned to the same object issues no UPDATE.
items.solution: detect_lyrics copies job.params before mutating, and a _commit_params() helper assigns a fresh {**params} on every commit in detect_lyrics and detect_tones.
items.regression_risk: Any new incremental write to Job.params that reuses the dict object silently loses the write.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: .phrase-levels is a JSON file DLC Builder reads from the project directory; the bundle shipped none (the first attempts wrongly created a directory).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Static per-stage percentages, no log during imports, unbounded Demucs subprocess.
items.solution: Interpolated progress, commits/log lines during imports, a 30-min Demucs timeout and a task time limit.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: GP5 NoteType.tie and GPIF <Tie destination="true"> were not handled.
items.solution: GP5 extends the last note per string on NoteType.tie; GP7 folds <Tie destination> into the previous note via _merge_ties.
items.regression_risk: Tie chains and the tied note's own effects can be lost in the fold.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The GP pipeline did not return the lyrics for storage in params.

items.regression_risk: Stored rows then win over the file.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Extension gate not updated after the GPIF parser landed.
items.solution: Move .gp to accepted (only .gpx rejected), update accept= and messages.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Looked only in Properties.

items.solution: Shift lyric draw/highlight by leadInBuilt; store currentPlayheadT - leadInBuilt.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request

items.solution: stringLabel = standard MIDI + tuning_offsets mapped to a note name.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: No --no-playlist, inherited stdin, no timeout.
items.solution: Run python -m yt_dlp with stdin=DEVNULL, --no-playlist, socket timeout and an overall ceiling.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: TF SavedModel incompatible with the installed TF.
items.solution: Prefer the bundled ONNX model, pin onnxruntime, wrap errors.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: uvicorn reloader parent/child split.
items.solution: Run uvicorn without --reload; add a command-line fallback to kill the worker.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Heavy import as an availability check.
items.solution: Use importlib.util.find_spec instead of importing whisperx.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Browsers throttle or freeze a background tab's timers, so its 4 s heartbeats stopped and the watchdog treated 15 s of silence as a closed tab.
items.solution: The tab reports itself hidden (POST /heartbeat?hidden=1), which suspends the idle kill; only /closing or the 30-minute safety net stop the server, and a poll gap over 5 s (system sleep) resets the clock.
items.regression_risk: Treating silence as a close again would kill an idle but open tab.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Any heartbeat, visible or hidden, cleared _closing_at.
items.solution: Only a visible heartbeat (a refresh that came back) cancels a pending /closing; a hidden one updates the heartbeat state only.
items.regression_risk: Letting hidden heartbeats clear the close again would bring the regression back.

items.author: F100Pilot (the maintainer)
items.root_cause: No force path.
items.solution: DELETE ?force=true with a stronger confirmation in the UI.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Bottom band too small.
items.solution: Bottom band widened to 59 px (single SB constant).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Linear normalisation range wrong.
items.solution: Normalise flatness on a log10 scale and rebalance weights.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Wrote an anchor, not the offset.
items.solution: Compute and set the offset; warn if it would be negative.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Missing redraw.
items.solution: Redraw and refresh the pending summary.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Tempo events read from the charted track only.
items.solution: Scan all tracks for tempo events (dedup by tick).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: tuning_offsets not applied.
items.solution: Include the arrangement's tuning offset in the tick's MIDI.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The XML writer wrote tone change times unchanged, including on a note's time.
items.solution: _safe_tone_time moves each tone change 20 ms before the note it starts on, strictly after the previous note (halfway when tighter).
items.regression_risk: A change to the nudge rule could push a tone change across a note.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Plain voice not bypassing the cabinet.
items.solution: Route the plain voice straight to the output.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: null sentinel used for an intentional empty value.
items.solution: Send the full tone state with concrete empties for GP jobs.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Missing showArr call.
items.solution: Redraw from renderToneChangesList and base/extra handlers.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The packer did not emit the retail layout the engine enumerates (found by byte-diffing a working DLC Builder PSARC).
items.solution: The packer names the file *_p.psarc, writes appid.appid, the xblock, the vendored flat models, the aggregate graph, separate .json entries and .hsan headers, the SNG under songs/bin/generic, and absolute TOC offsets.
items.regression_risk: A layout change that drops any of these files can hide the song again.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The SNG was written without the retail 8-byte header, zero IV and zlib-compressed, size-prefixed payload.
items.solution: crypto.pack_sng writes the retail format (header 0x4A / platform 3, zero IV, AES-256-CTR of a zlib payload prefixed with its size) for instrument and vocals SNGs.
items.regression_risk: Changing the SNG container write breaks every song.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The beat struct format was <fhhi (12 bytes) instead of <fhhii (16 bytes with a mask).
items.solution: The beat is 16 bytes with its mask and carries the running measure number and beat-within-measure, as retail does.
items.regression_risk: Any layout change in the beat table misaligns the whole SNG.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: slide_to / slide_unpitch_to defaulted to 0 instead of the -1 (0xFF) sentinel.
items.solution: slide_to / slide_unpitch_to are signed bytes defaulting to -1 for single notes and 0xFF per string for chord notes.
items.regression_risk: Low: a genuine slide still writes its target fret.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Anchor times were the phrase iteration start time instead of the note where the hand position changes.
items.solution: Anchors start at the note where the fret-hand position changes, strictly increasing, each ending where the next begins.
items.regression_risk: Anchor placement changes can overlap anchors again.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: SNG phrases were built only from arrangement.sections.
items.solution: sng._default_sections synthesizes a COUNT/riff/END phrase timeline when the arrangement has no sections.
items.regression_risk: Phrase generation changes could leave a chart without phrases.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: manifest.py wrote placeholder zeros instead of stats from the compiled SNG.
items.solution: manifest.arrangement_stats derives the note counts and phrase/iteration/section tables from the compiled SNG.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The 'Toolkit version:' line held a custom, non-numeric string.
items.solution: manifest.TOOLKIT_VERSION is the numeric '2.9.2.1-5df928a5' every working reference carries.
items.regression_risk: Changing that line hides the song again.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: container.pack_entries wrote zeroed 16-byte name hashes (and a zero name-block hash).
items.solution: container.pack_entries writes md5(path) for each entry and the fixed retail constant for the name block.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Wrong DDS header field.
items.solution: Set mip count 1 and convert the real cover to DXT1 textures.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: No preview clip.
items.solution: Extract a ~28 s clip with ffmpeg for the preview bank.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Missing preview flags.
items.solution: generate_soundbank(preview=True) sets maxNumInstance=1 and related flags.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: No grouping of positions into windows.
items.solution: Greedy stable windows of at most 5 frets; first anchor from the song start.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Inconsistent metadata/hero triples.
items.solution: Density-graduated per-phrase ceilings and retail (max/4, max/2, max) triples.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: The parsers used the notated duration as sustain without any gap.
items.solution: domain apply_sustain_gap trims a sustain to end min(50 ms, 15 %) before the next note on the same string (pitched slides untouched), in both parsers.
items.regression_risk: Any later re-timing of notes must re-apply the gap.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: _compress_block returned 0 for every raw block, including partial ones.
items.solution: _compress_block returns len(block) % BLOCK_SIZE for a raw block (full block 0, partial block its size).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Anchors were built globally from note positions and never split at phrase-iteration boundaries.
items.solution: from_arrangement splits any anchor crossing a phrase boundary into per-phrase pieces with the same hand position.
items.regression_risk: Anchor building changes can let an anchor cross a phrase start again.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: _build_level reused the full-chart fingerprint and anchor-extension lists.
items.solution: _build_level keeps only the hand shapes its own notes reference and rebuilds slide anchor-extensions from its own notes.
items.regression_risk: A per-level structure taken from the full chart could crash again.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Notes within a beat-strength tier were taken in plain time order.
items.solution: Within each tier notes are visited in bisection order (_spread_order) so a partial tier is spread over the phrase.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Segmentation started from body == start.
items.solution: Segment from the last phrase's start regardless.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Placeholder manifest values.
items.solution: Fill from the chart's density and note-count ratios.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Merge span 5.
items.solution: Max merge span 4.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Attributed at the time to back-to-back hand shapes; later traced elsewhere.
items.solution: Stopped emitting fingerprints.
items.regression_risk: High: the attributed cause was wrong.

items.root_cause: _note_mask reused verbatim for chord strings.
items.solution: Technique bits only; dedupe entries.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Placeholder 0.

items.regression_risk: Medium: later replaced by DLC Builder's generator.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Anchors not built per level.
items.solution: Rebuild anchors per level from that level's notes.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Missing bendValues.
items.solution: _append_note_el emits <bendValues>.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: No fog/beam events were generated from the arrangement.

items.root_cause: from_vocals wrote note 0 instead of VOCAL_NOTE = 254.
items.solution: from_vocals and the embedded vocals path use VOCAL_NOTE (254).

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: SymbolsHeader/Texture/Definition were written empty.
items.solution: The song-independent atlas is vendored as vocals_symbols.bin and spliced into every vocals SNG; read_sng skips its entries.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Point placed at attack instead of note end.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: Hardcoded.

items.author: Claude (AI coding assistant), on the maintainer's request
items.root_cause: has-lyrics was keyed on lyrics_status alone.
